Package com.hiface.sdk.detection

Class DetectedFace

java.lang.Object
com.hiface.sdk.detection.DetectedFace
public final class DetectedFace extends java.lang.Object
A face in one frame. Coordinates are rotated, unmirrored image pixels. x and y identify the top-left corner, not the center.

Instances are returned by the SDK and are read-only to applications. Live detection exposes the face box, confidence, five landmarks, optional head pose, and optional 468-point landmarks.
